Career Opportunities

Why BillRun!?

BillRun! is all about big data and open source solutions. We are not just on the cutting edge of Telcom technology, we are actually the leaders, setting the standards for many services provided by both large and small providers.

We are a growing bootstrapped startup, based in Tel Aviv (just a five-minute walk from Azrieli), offering great benefits and a positive workplace atmosphere. We are proud of our staff’s accomplishments and are looking for additional talented people to join our hub of innovation. If you are looking to reach the next level and want to join a great and motivated team, contact us today.
